name: 梁斯寧
objective: This current course emphasizes a holistic view of business communication in a global context.  Given that business communication across from fields of business activities is now made possible by the English language, the course thus aims to develop the ability to use critical skills essential to successful communication in English, with particular emphases on forms of formal communications that are highly visible within and outside business organizations. Informal communication skills are also incorporated to address workplace situations to identify the relevant communication needs.
課程進度(1-16週):
Tentative course schedule
Week 1 Course overview
Week 2 Holiday
Week 3 Business letter
Week 4-5 Job application
Week 6-7 Interview
Week 8-9 Mid-term assessment
Week 10-11 Advertisements
Week 12 Launching a product
Week 13-14 Sales letter
Week 15 Entrepreneurship 
Week 16 Final assessment
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Week 17: Students use AI critically to revise selected business writing completed during the semester and document their AI interactions and revision decisions.

Week 18: Students complete and submit a business writing portfolio containing their original writing and revision worksheets (documenting their AI-assisted revision process, and final revised versions)
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Students will be able to:

apply business genre conventions and writing principles to revise their writing;
use AI critically and responsibly as a writing revision tool;
evaluate AI-generated suggestions and make informed revision decisions; and
compile a portfolio demonstrating their writing development.

Students will complete and submit an AI-assisted business writing portfolio
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          10% of the course grade
